content: Agent search providers: Brave Search API (2000 free q/mo, fastest ~0.7s, independent index), Tavily (1000 credits/mo, @tavily/core 0.7.x), Exa (semantic, 0 credit, exa-js 2.x), SearXNG self-hosted, DuckDuckGo free; Jina Reader r.jina.ai/<url> for fetch-to-markdown; search+extract pipeline matters more than search quality.
